featuredStory.title: From a borrowed room to Kishangarh's first STEM & reading hub
featuredStory.quote: Three years ago my daughter hesitated to read aloud. Last month she demonstrated a solar pump model to the district board.
description: Together with the village council, we renovated an old grain storehouse, added rooftop solar, stocked 800 books, and trained local youth mentors. Today, 240 children attend daily.
